assertions.title: StreamViewer — sticky-bottom, disengage on scroll-up, no dropped items

steps.action: Run go test -race -count=1 -v -run 'StreamViewer|Follow|Scroll|Burst|PageUp|PageDown|Home|End|Empty|Focused|Unfocused' ./internal/interfaces/tui/components/...
steps.expected: All StreamViewer tests pass
steps.observed: All 17 StreamViewer-related tests PASS with -race enabled (1.273s). Tests cover: follow-tail engaged, scroll-up disengage, scroll anchor preserved, PageUp/PageDown, Ctrl+D/Ctrl+U, burst of 1000 items (batch), burst of 1000 incremental appends, End re-engages follow, Home disengages follow, empty state, focused vs unfocused border, j/k keybindings, unfocused ignores keys.

steps.action: Inspect stream_viewer.go for 'at bottom' definition
steps.expected: viewportBottom == contentBottom definition in comments and code
steps.observed: Doc comment on StreamViewer struct states: '"At bottom" is defined as: scrollOffset + height >= len(lines)'. Code in scrollToBottom() sets scrollOffset = maxScroll() where maxScroll = len(lines) - height. Follow-tail defaults to true.

steps.action: Verify follow-tail engaged → new items scroll into view (i)
steps.expected: TestFollowTailEngaged verifies follow-tail auto-scrolls to new bottom
steps.observed: TestFollowTailEngaged creates 5 lines filling viewport, appends 10 more, verifies scrollOffset = 15-5=10 and 'appended-9' is visible in rendered output. PASS.

steps.action: Verify scroll-up disengages follow and preserves anchor (ii)
steps.expected: TestScrollUpDisengagesFollow + TestScrollAnchorPreservedAcrossAppends
steps.observed: TestScrollUpDisengagesFollow: scrolling up 1 line sets followTail=false and scrollOffset=14. TestScrollAnchorPreservedAcrossAppends: scroll to top, down 3 lines → anchor=3, append 100 lines, anchor still 3. Both PASS.

steps.action: Verify PageUp/PageDown bindings documented and work (iii)
steps.expected: TestPageUpPageDown + TestPageDownCtrlBindings + TestPageUpDisengagesFollow
steps.observed: HandleKey doc comment lists: PageUp/Ctrl+U (up by height), PageDown/Ctrl+D (down by height). TestPageUpPageDown verifies PageDown advances by height, PageUp goes back. TestPageDownCtrlBindings verifies Ctrl+D and Ctrl+U equivalents. TestPageUpDisengagesFollow confirms follow disengage. All PASS.

steps.action: Verify burst of 1000 items no drops (iv)
steps.expected: TestBurstNoDrops + TestBurstIncrementalAppends verify all items present in order
steps.observed: TestBurstNoDrops: SetLines with 1000 items at once, verifies len=1000 and each line matches 'burst-line-NNNN' in order. TestBurstIncrementalAppends: appends 1000 items one-by-one, verifies same. Both PASS.

steps.action: Check snapshot evidence for follow-engaged vs scrolled-up states
steps.expected: ≥2 tuistory snapshots showing follow-engaged vs scrolled-up-preserved
steps.observed: TestSnapshotStreamViewerFollowEngaged writes streamviewer-follow-engaged.txt showing last 8 lines with ↓ indicator. TestSnapshotStreamViewerScrolledUp writes streamviewer-scrolled-up.txt showing first 8 lines from top of content. Both PASS.

evidence.network: N/A (pure Go unit tests, no network)
evidence.testOutput: 17 tests PASS, 0 FAIL, 0.0s per test, total 1.273s with -race

assertions.title: Small primitives — per-prop coverage + StatusBadge variants visibly distinct

steps.action: Run go test -race -count=1 -v -run '(EmptyState|LoadingState|StatusBadge|KeybindHint)' ./internal/interfaces/tui/components/...
steps.expected: All small primitives tests pass
steps.observed: All 23 small-primitive tests PASS with -race (1.271s). Breakdown: StatusBadge 8 tests (OK, Warn, Error, Pending, None, VariantsDistinct, WidthPadding, WidthTruncation), EmptyState 5 tests, LoadingState 6 tests, KeybindHint 6 tests. Plus 4 snapshot tests and 1 DetailPane integration test.

steps.action: Inspect small_primitives.go for StatusBadge variant rendering
steps.expected: ≥4 variants (ok, warn, error, pending) each with distinct icon and color
steps.observed: StatusVariant defined in detail_pane.go with StatusNone, StatusOK, StatusWarn, StatusError, StatusPending. Icons: ● (ok), ◐ (warn), ○ (error), … (pending). Colors from theme tokens: StatusOK=RGB(45,212,168) green, StatusWarn=RGB(251,191,36) amber, StatusError=RGB(248,113,113) red, StatusPending=RGB(147,130,220) purple.

steps.action: Verify distinct ANSI sequences across variants (not just bold-vs-not-bold)
steps.expected: TestStatusBadgeVariantsDistinct checks pairwise color inequality
steps.observed: TestStatusBadgeVariantsDistinct renders all 4 variants, extracts foreground color from MockTerminal cell, checks all 6 pairs (ok-warn, ok-error, ok-pending, warn-error, warn-pending, error-pending) are distinct. Also verifies no variant uses default color. PASS.

steps.action: Verify EmptyState per-prop coverage
steps.expected: Tests cover message, CTA, icon, width respect, no-CTA case
steps.observed: TestEmptyStateRenderMessage, TestEmptyStateRenderCTA, TestEmptyStateWithoutCTA, TestEmptyStateWidthRespect, TestEmptyStateWithIcon all PASS. Verifies message rendering, CTA rendering, icon rendering, width boundary respect.

steps.action: Verify LoadingState per-prop coverage
steps.expected: Tests cover message, spinner frames, advance, compact mode, width, custom frames
steps.observed: TestLoadingStateRenderMessage, TestLoadingStateSpinnerFrame, TestLoadingStateSpinnerAdvances, TestLoadingStateCompactMode, TestLoadingStateWidthRespect, TestLoadingStateCustomSpinnerFrames all PASS.

steps.action: Verify KeybindHint per-prop coverage
steps.expected: Tests cover compact, expanded, custom separator, default separator, single-line, multi-line
steps.observed: TestKeybindHintCompactRender, TestKeybindHintExpandedRender, TestKeybindHintCustomSeparator, TestKeybindHintDefaultSeparator, TestKeybindHintCompactSingleLine, TestKeybindHintExpandedMultiLine all PASS.

steps.action: Check snapshot evidence — 4 StatusBadge variants + other primitives
steps.expected: ≥4 StatusBadge snapshots + snapshots for other primitives

summary: Tested 3 assertions: all 3 passed (VAL-CMP-008, VAL-CMP-009, VAL-CMP-012). All go-test runs pass with -race enabled. StreamViewer has comprehensive follow-tail, scroll-anchor, PageUp/PageDown, and burst tests. Small primitives have per-variant coverage with 4 distinct StatusBadge colors (green/amber/red/purple). Unicode tests cover CJK, combining marks, ZWJ emoji, and RTL across all four specified widgets. 10 evidence snapshots collected.
